llm.summary: This skill is a narrow, disclosed file-based todo manager that only guides creation and maintenance of markdown task files in a project todo directory.

dimensions.detail: Local file reads and writes are proportionate to the todo-tracking purpose and are limited by convention to the project todos/ directory.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown, YAML metadata, and references only, with no executable scripts or package install behavior; the OpenAI agent metadata disables implicit invocation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to local markdown task files and simple shell commands such as ls, grep, cp, and mv for todo management; there are no hidden instructions, network calls, credential handling, or unrelated data access.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally persists task state by writing and renaming markdown files, but this persistence is visible, expected, and directly aligned with its purpose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is project todo tracking, and the instructions consistently describe creating, listing, triaging, renaming, and completing markdown todo files under todos/.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want agents to maintain persistent project todo files. Review generated todos before relying on them, since the skill can create and rename local markdown files in the project todo workflow, but the inspected artifacts do not show credential use, background execution, network access, or destructive behavior.
